entries.text: Under a heavy-run, Spark and DuckDB now derive their default memory caps from the admitted memory budget less a measured non-heap allowance, and fail before starting when an explicit driver_memory or memory_limit cannot fit the budget.
benchbox run --quiet now prints the captured error output to stderr when the run fails, so a failed quiet run no longer exits without a message.

Heavy-work admission now requires a clean host for a hold window, the watchdog reports the largest processes outside a breaching tree, and make heavy-run accepts HEAVY_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=1 for a bounded re-run after outside memory pressure stops a small tree.
